result.quote: “You will see it with your own eyes,” replied Elisha, “but you will not eat any of it.”
result.reason: The key is supported: the officer will not eat the flour or barley. However, the broad question “What happens” also permits the distinct answer that he will see the foretold event with his own eyes. The wording should specify which consequence is being requested; additionally, the window calls him an “officer,” not a captain.
